name: budva-push-stall
title: Diagnose push pipeline stall (deliveries stopped reaching the target)
description: budva engine silently stopped pushing to the configured webhook target after some uptime: source chats active, endpoint gateway receives zero inbound requests while stalled, log stays clean, manual `docker compose restart engine` immediately restores delivery and the stop recurs. Producer-side diagnosis: find the exact stop point, deliver the minimal fix. The target is a black box (accepted/rejected/unreachable); no target-side change from this task.
scope: producer side only; target treated as a black box; no target-side changes from within this task
creator: killbus
notes: Root cause CONFIRMED 2026-10-29: reentrant sync.RWMutex self-deadlock in the single-serial task queue — processQueue (internal/infra/queue/repo.go:100-112) held the write lock across task execution and the media-album task (internal/app/handler/service.go:573) called Add from inside itself (service.go:638/:644); trigger = any media album reaching processMediaAlbum via a matching configured rule. Evidence: kill.log (SIGQUIT dump while stalled) + research/root-cause.md. Independently confirmed by research/team-b-audit-report.md. Minimal fix IMPLEMENTED on diag/budva-push-stall (processQueue releases the lock before executeTask) + regression tests; Team B implementation audit (report §9) findings TB-IMPL-P2-01 and TB-IMPL-P3-01 resolved. CI GREEN: ci-test.yml run 40995828178 on code tip 89f40b8 = success (go vet clean; ok internal/app/handler 3.166s incl. the incident-shape regression test executed in the TDLib-provisioned CI; ok internal/infra/queue 3.007s, 16 tests). Branch tip e7999d7 (docs-only on top). Remaining: open PR + squash-merge, v* tag push to refresh the box :latest image, then PRD runtime acceptance (fixed build, album + text reach the configured endpoint without a restart, user confirmation).
